senses.gloss:
m. (-रः)
1 The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.)
2 A kind of leprosy.
3 A threshold.
4 A eunuch.
n. (-रं)
Copper; see उडुम्बर, it is also written ऊडुम्बर.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant: see दन्तिका; also उडुम्बरपर्णी and ऊडुम्बरपर्णी.

n. (-लं)
A gum-resin, Bdellium.
mn. (-लः-लं)
1 A wooden mortar used for freeing rice from the husk, by pounding it with a pestle.
2 Any mortar.
E.
उदू for उद् up, and खल what goes, affix अच्; also उडूखल and उलूखल.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Married.
2 Coarse, gross, heavy.
3 Material, substantial.
4 Much, exceeding.
E.
उद् up, वह to bear, and क्त affix, deriv. irr.
